prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a hit while turning left. The patient had 5 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1369; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the vehicle was struck while the patient was turning left. The patient reported immediate pain and swelling in the right knee, with difficulty bearing weight in the first days after the incident. Initial examination showed moderate effusion, tenderness over the medial joint line, and reduced range of motion, with pain limiting full flexion. Ligamentous stability testing was limited by guarding. Plain radiographs showed no acute fracture, and a provisional diagnosis of medial meniscal strain with knee sprain was made.

Over five visits, treatment consisted of activity modification, a structured physical therapy program focused on quadriceps strengthening and gradual range-of-motion restoration, and anti-inflammatory medication as needed. Swelling decreased steadily and weight-bearing tolerance improved by the third visit. At the most recent visit, the patient was ambulating without an assistive device, flexion had improved substantially, and residual discomfort was primarily with prolonged kneeling and stair descent. Continued home exercise and activity pacing were recommended, with re-evaluation if symptoms persist or mechanical locking develops.
